cases.input: A lineage changes from skill to competency in a later release.
cases.expect: A conforming validator must reject the type change and require a new concept lineage.

cases.input: A deprecated concept splits into two narrower successors.
cases.expect: Both pinned successors remain guidance-only links and the predecessor stays resolvable.

cases.input: An issued scheme release changes bytes under the same digest address.
A preferred label has no language tag.
Two preferred labels use the same language tag.
cases.expect: The second preferred label must be rejected.

cases.input: A competency composition cites a skill code without release pin.
A definition-level authorityEvidenceRef points to a person's assessment.
A one-way concept map is used in reverse.
cases.expect: No reverse relation or identity substitution may be inferred.

cases.input: A→B and B→C maps are composed automatically.
cases.expect: No A→C map may be inferred.

cases.input: Equivalent-for-declared-purpose is used to deduplicate scheme concepts.
A mapping declares empty residual loss.
A mapping authority issues a mapping without target endorsement.
cases.expect: The mapping remains valid only as the issuer's assertion and exposes endorsedByTargetAuthority false.

cases.input: A mapping was recorded after its validFrom.
cases.expect: Valid-at and known-at queries return only the mapping known at the requested transaction time.

cases.input: A publication calls the reconstructed title the confirmed registered name.
cases.expect: Publication must remain blocked while registry metadata is unconfirmed.

cases.input: A release cites provider agreement as validation.
A finalized assessment emits a level result.
cases.expect: It pins both definition release and scale version; an unscaled level must be rejected.
It records a nonLevelOutcome and never level zero.

cases.input: A fixture names an external scheme release without digest pin.
cases.expect: It cannot count as acceptance evidence.
